ipn.setting.sort_rule.tooltip: How stacks are ordered when sorting inventory or containers.
ipn.setting.sort_rule.name: Display Name (A-Z)
ipn.setting.fill_direction.tooltip: Arrange sorted stacks row-by-row horizontally or column-by-column vertically.
ipn.setting.sort_hotbar.tooltip: Also sort unlocked hotbar slots (0-8) when sorting player inventory.
ipn.setting.transfer_hotbar.tooltip: Allow Move Matching, Dump All, and Throw All to include unlocked hotbar slots.
ipn.setting.move_match_mode.tooltip: Choose whether Move Match puts matching Item+NBT stacks into empty chest slots or only tops up existing partial chest stacks.
ipn.setting.auto_refill.tooltip: Replace near-broken tools or depleted stacks in your active hand or offhand from main inventory.
ipn.setting.refill_threshold.tooltip: Swap a held tool when remaining durability reaches or falls below this value (0 = wait until broken).
ipn.setting.show_buttons.tooltip: Display Sort, Lock Mode, Container Transfer, and Profile buttons beside inventory/chest screens.
ipn.setting.highlight_matching.tooltip: Highlight all slots matching the hovered item's ID and NBT across chest and inventory.
ipn.setting.panel_position.tooltip: Where the IPN panel docks (or drag the IPN header anytime to move it manually).
ipn.setting.prevent_locked_quickmove.too: Block Shift-Click (QuickMove) and Drop (Q) on locked player inventory slots.
ipn.setting.show_search_bar.tooltip: Display a draggable item search bar above chest and inventory screens that searches Name, Lore, and Item ID.
ipn.setting.keep_search_query.tooltip: Keep your search text when closing a chest/inventory so you can search across multiple chests. When OFF, search clears automatically on close.
